title: Calvin Oftana admits regrets after Gilas' failed Asiad title defense but proud to represent PH
summary: Gilas Pilipinas' Calvin Oftana admitted regrets after the Philippines failed to retain the Asian Games men’s 5-on-5 hoops title at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026.
